title: Oven-Crisped Smoky Uruguayan Serrano Ham Wrap
description: A rich, crispy, kid-friendly Uruguayan dish featuring serrano ham, with a smoky flavor and anti-inflammatory-friendly ingredients, wrapped in a corn husk.
instructions: Soak the corn husks in water for at least 30 minutes.
Lay a corn husk flat on a work surface and arrange 2 slices of Serrano ham in the center.
Sprinkle smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper over the ham.
Drizzle lime juice over the ham and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Fold the bottom half of the corn husk up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 3 more wraps.
Place the wraps seam-side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the corn husks are crispy and golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
